svg.text: DETAIL S (1:2): STAGE INDEX ON Y = 0 (JAR STOP)
1. Bearings greased for life (H1 food grade); the product zone below the hub has no bearing: both lip seals face down.
2. Spindle runout at the coupling face ≤ 0.05 TIR (ITP T6); auger tip in the tube within 0.3 of centre with the hopper full (T12).
3. Agitator and auger turn independently: auger 0-1,500 rpm (servo 2:1), agitator 30 rpm (gearmotor 60 rpm, chain 2:1).
4. Tension: belt by sliding the bridge (4 slots), chain by sliding the gearmotor (4 slots); deflection 4 mm at mid span.
